EKM_HERITAGE.desc: Five hundred years of Kochi in one easy day: Chinese fishing nets, the oldest European church in India, a Dutch palace of murals, Jew Town's synagogue and a Marine Drive sunset.
EKM_HERITAGE.itin:
9:00 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup from 7:45 AM)
9:45 AM — Fort Kochi: fishing nets & churches: The giant Chinese nets at the water's edge, St Francis Church (Vasco da Gama's first resting place) and Santa Cruz Basilica. (Modest dress in the churches)
11:30 AM — Mattancherry Palace: The 'Dutch Palace' with its Ramayana murals and royal portraits. (Closed Fridays · entry own expense)
12:30 PM — Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue: Antique shops, spice warehouses and the 1568 synagogue. Lunch break here, own expense. (Synagogue closed Fri & Sat)
2:45 PM — Kerala Folklore Museum: Masks, costumes and carved wooden halls from across South India. (Entry own expense)
4:30 PM — Marine Drive: A walk along the backwater promenade as the boats come in.
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_HERITAGE.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Mattancherry Palace is closed on Fridays; the synagogue on Fridays, Saturdays and Jewish holidays. On those days we swap in the Hill Palace Museum at Tripunithura — same price.
👗 What to wear: Shoulders and knees covered for the churches, synagogue and palace. No photos inside the synagogue or the palace galleries.
🚶 Walking: Fort Kochi and Jew Town are best on foot — about 3–4 km of easy walking in all. Wear comfortable shoes; lanes are uneven in places.
✈️ Flying in?: We can pick you up at Cochin Airport in the morning — it adds about an hour. Or end your day at the airport for an evening flight: ask us.
EKM_HERITAGE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_HERITAGE.exc: Lunch; Palace, synagogue and museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_HERITAGE.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

EKM_CHERAI.desc: Island-hop up Vypin over the Goshree bridges: Puthuvype's lighthouse, Munambam fishing harbour, a 1503 Portuguese fort, Chinese nets on the backwaters and Cherai's golden beach.
EKM_CHERAI.itin:
8:30 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:30 AM — Puthuvype beach & lighthouse: A quiet beach below Kerala's tallest lighthouse, at Kochi's harbour mouth. (Tower visits: check timings)
10:45 AM — Munambam fishing harbour: Boats landing the catch at Vypin's northern tip. (Wet, busy wharf)
12:00 PM — Pallipuram Fort: The 1503 Portuguese fort — oldest standing European fort in India. (Muziris Heritage site)
1:00 PM — Cherai backwaters & lunch: Chinese nets and prawn farms; seafood lunch, own expense.
3:15 PM — Cherai beach: Golden sand and gentle waves till late afternoon. (No swimming at red flags)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_CHERAI.gtk:
🏖️ Beach safety: Swim only near the lifeguards and where flags allow — never at red flags or in the monsoon months. Breakwater rocks at Munambam are off limits when waves are high.
🏰 Heritage notes: Pallipuram Fort is a protected site; if the caretaker isn't in, we see it from outside. The Pallipuram Basilica is next door — modest dress inside.
🌞 Sun & sand: Little shade on the beaches — bring a hat, sunscreen and water. Carry a change of clothes if you plan to get wet at Cherai.
✈️ Flying in?: We can pick you up at Cochin Airport in the morning. Or end your day at the airport — Cherai is about an hour away.
EKM_CHERAI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_CHERAI.exc: Lunch; Lighthouse and any entry fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_CHERAI.carry: Swimwear and a change of clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Sandals for the sand; Cash for small stalls

EKM_ATHIRAPPILLY.desc: Kerala's mightiest waterfalls in a day: the Thumboormuzhi butterfly garden, thundering Athirappilly, roadside Charpa and the forest rapids of Vazhachal on the Chalakudy river.
EKM_ATHIRAPPILLY.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on the way, 8:30)
9:45 AM — Thumboormuzhi dam & butterfly garden: A riverside garden by the old weir, with a hanging bridge. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Athirappilly Falls: The top viewpoint, then the path to the base if open. Lunch nearby, own expense. (Entry own expense)
2:00 PM — Charpa Falls: A cascade right beside the forest road. (Flows in the monsoon)
2:15 PM — Vazhachal Falls: Wide rapids over black rock at the forest's edge. (Viewing area only)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_ATHIRAPPILLY.gtk:
🌧️ Rain & closures: The forest department closes the falls, or the path to the base, in heavy rain or high water. If a stop is shut, we spend longer at the others — we check the evening before.
🚯 Plastic-free forest: Disposable plastic is not allowed in the forest area; bags may be checked at the entry. Bring a reusable bottle; snacks in boxes, not plastic covers.
🐒 Monkeys & wildlife: Monkeys at the falls snatch food and bags — keep snacks out of sight. Elephants sometimes cross the forest road; everyone stays inside if we stop.
🥾 The walk down: The path to the base of Athirappilly is steep, with many uneven steps — the climb back is slow. Wear shoes with grip; skip it if you have knee or heart trouble.
EKM_ATHIRAPPILLY.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_ATHIRAPPILLY.exc: Lunch; Falls and garden entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_ATHIRAPPILLY.carry: Shoes with good grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Reusable water bottle; Cash for entry tickets

EKM_ALAPPUZHA.desc: Glide through Alappuzha's canals and paddy fields on a shikara, walk the old pier and 1862 lighthouse on Alappuzha beach, then finish on palm-lined Marari beach.
EKM_ALAPPUZHA.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
10:00 AM — Shikara canal ride: About 2½ hours on Punnamada lake, narrow canals and paddy fields. (Boat paid direct)
12:45 PM — Lunch & Alappuzha beach: Karimeen lunch in town (own expense), then the old pier and promenade. (No swimming here)
3:00 PM — Alappuzha lighthouse: The 1862 lighthouse — climb up for views over the coast. (Tower: check timings)
4:00 PM — Marari beach: A quiet fishing-village beach lined with coconut palms. (No swimming at red flags)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_ALAPPUZHA.gtk:
🛶 The boat ride: Shikaras are run by licensed operators near Finishing Point; the fare is paid direct to the operator. Life jackets for everyone; children always with an adult.
🌊 Beach safety: No swimming at Alappuzha beach — strong currents. At Marari, only near the lifeguards and flags. No sea bathing at all in the monsoon months.
🚧 Highway works: Elevated-highway works on NH 66 between Aroor and Thuravoor can slow the drive — we leave on time. If traffic is bad, we shorten the lighthouse stop, not the boat ride.
✈️ Flying in?: We can pick you up at Cochin Airport in the morning — it adds about an hour. Or end your day at the airport for a late flight: ask us.
EKM_ALAPPUZHA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_ALAPPUZHA.exc: Shikara fare (paid direct); Lunch and lighthouse entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_ALAPPUZHA.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Light cotton clothes; Cash for the boat and snacks; Sandals for the beach

EKM_KUMARAKOM.desc: A slow lakeside day on Vembanad: morning birdwatching at Kumarakom sanctuary, a boat on the lake, driftwood art at Bay Island museum and old Thazhathangady on the Meenachil river.
EKM_KUMARAKOM.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:15 AM — Kumarakom bird sanctuary: A shaded lakeside trail with herons, egrets and cormorants. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Vembanad lake boat & lunch: An hour on Kerala's largest lake, then a karimeen lunch, own expense. (Boat paid direct)
1:45 PM — Bay Island Driftwood Museum: Driftwood shaped into sculptures by a retired teacher. (Check timings · entry own expense)
3:15 PM — Thazhathangady: Old riverside trading street and its centuries-old Juma Masjid. (Mosque seen from outside)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_KUMARAKOM.gtk:
🐦 Birdwatching: Mornings are best; November to February brings the most migratory birds. Walk quietly, no feeding; binoculars help.
🗓️ Timings: The Driftwood Museum may close on some weekdays — we check before your trip. If it's shut, we add time on the lake or at Thazhathangady.
🕌 Respect at the mosque: We see the Juma Masjid and its carvings from outside; entry is at the mosque's discretion. Modest dress for everyone in Thazhathangady.
✈️ Flying in?: We can pick you up at Cochin Airport in the morning — it adds about an hour. Or end your day at the airport for a late flight: ask us.
EKM_KUMARAKOM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_KUMARAKOM.exc: Lake boat (paid direct); Lunch, sanctuary and museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_KUMARAKOM.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Binoculars if you have them; Insect repellent; Clothes covering shoulders and knees

EKM_THATTEKAD.desc: An early morning with hornbills and kingfishers at the Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary, the Periyar dam and forest boulders of Bhoothathankettu, and a walk across the Inchathotty hanging bridge.
EKM_THATTEKAD.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Early start for the birds)
7:30 AM — Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary, Thattekad: Forest trails on the Periyar: Malabar grey hornbills, kingfishers and, with luck, the Sri Lanka frogmouth. Breakfast near the gate. (Entry, guides & boats paid direct)
11:00 AM — Bhoothathankettu dam: The Periyar barrage and its reservoir, with an optional boat ride on the lake. (Boating paid direct)
12:00 PM — Old Bhoothathankettu: A short forest walk to the giant boulders of the 'demons' dam' legend. Lunch after, own expense. (Forest walk · good shoes)
2:45 PM — Inchathotty hanging bridge: Walk one of Kerala's longest suspension footbridges, high over the Periyar. In the dry season we may swap in the Paniyeli Poru rapids. (No entering the water)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_THATTEKAD.gtk:
🐦 Birding tips: Birds are most active from 7 to 10 AM — the early start is worth it. Walk quietly in dull colours. A local bird guide (paid direct) can be booked for keen birders.
💧 River safety: The Periyar has strong undercurrents — no swimming or wading anywhere on this tour. Paniyeli Poru and some forest trails close in heavy rain; we re-confirm the evening before.
🎟️ Fees & timings: Sanctuary entry, camera fees, guides and boat rides are paid direct at the counters. Sanctuary entry closes in the late afternoon, so we go there first.
👟 What to wear: Walking shoes with grip; trails and rocks can be slippery. June–September: raincoat, and leech socks for the forest walks.
EKM_THATTEKAD.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_THATTEKAD.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Sanctuary, guide and boating fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_THATTEKAD.carry: Binoculars; Walking shoes; Dull-coloured clothes; Cash for entry and boat fees

EKM_KALADY.desc: Adi Shankara's birthplace on the Periyar at Kalady, the tower that tells his life, the hilltop St Thomas shrine at Malayattoor and the forest elephant shelter at Kodanad.
EKM_KALADY.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:15 AM — Kalady: Shankara's birthplace: The Sringeri Math shrines with his mother Aryamba's samadhi, the old Sri Krishna temple and the Periyar ghat of the crocodile legend. (Modest dress · no photos in the Math)
10:45 AM — Keerthi Stambha Mandapam: The tall octagonal tower telling Shankara's life, with a ramp up to views over the Periyar. (Entry own expense)
11:45 AM — Malayattoor Kurisumudi: The St Thomas shrine on the hilltop: a steep climb past the Stations of the Cross to wide views. Lunch at the foot of the hill after, own expense. (Steep climb · about 1 hr up)
3:15 PM — Kodanad Abhayaranyam: The forest department's elephant shelter and deer park, just across the Periyar from Malayattoor. (Entry own expense · check status)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_KALADY.gtk:
🛕 Temple etiquette: Shoulders and knees covered; footwear off inside the shrines. The Sringeri Math closes from about 12:30 to 4 PM — that's why Kalady comes first.
⛰️ The Malayattoor climb: A steep, rocky path — allow about two hours up and down. Not for guests with knee, heart or breathing problems; they can rest at the church at the foot of the hill.
🗓️ Pilgrim season: In Lent, especially Holy Week and the Sunday after Easter, the hill takes huge crowds. On those dates we may reorder the day or skip the climb.
🐘 Abhayaranyam: Visiting hours are set by the forest department and can change. We re-confirm the day before; if it's closed, we spend the time by the Periyar.
EKM_KALADY.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_KALADY.exc: Lunch; Tower and shelter entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_KALADY.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Water bottle for the climb; Cash for entry fees

EKM_PALACE.desc: The royal side of Kochi: the Chottanikkara Devi temple, the Kochi kings' Hill Palace and their temple at Tripunithura, then an afternoon of nets, crab farms and a country boat at Kumbalangi.
EKM_PALACE.itin:
8:30 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:15 AM — Chottanikkara Bhagavathy temple: One of Kerala's most visited Devi temples, with the lower Keezhkkavu shrine. (Temple dress code)
10:30 AM — Poornathrayeesa temple: The old royal temple of the Kochi kings in the heart of Tripunithura — a short stop if open. (Optional · dress code)
11:15 AM — Hill Palace Museum: The Kochi royal family's palace complex: crowns, palanquins, paintings and a deer park. Lunch in Tripunithura after, own expense. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
2:45 PM — Kumbalangi village: Kerala's model tourism village: Chinese nets, crab and fish farms, coir work and a country-boat ride on the backwaters. (Boat ride paid direct)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_PALACE.gtk:
🗓️ Days & timings: Hill Palace is closed on Mondays, so this tour does not run then. Temples close around midday — that's why we see them in the morning.
👗 Temple dress: Men: mundu or trousers, shirts off where asked. Women: saree, churidar or long skirt. No shorts. Some shrines admit Hindus only — non-Hindu guests can see the grounds and outside.
🛶 Kumbalangi: The country boat, fishing demos and farm visits are paid direct to the village operators. Life jackets on in the boat; no boating in storms.
🌞 Comfort: Kumbalangi is open and sunny in the afternoon — hat, sunscreen and water. Mosquitoes by the water near dusk — repellent helps.
EKM_PALACE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_PALACE.exc: Lunch; Palace entry, boat ride & village activities; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_PALACE.carry: Temple-friendly clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Mosquito repellent; Cash for entry & boat

EKM_GURUVAYUR.desc: An early drive for darshan at Guruvayur's Sri Krishna temple and Mammiyoor, the Punnathur Kotta elephants, and an optional stop at Thrissur's Vadakkunnathan.
EKM_GURUVAYUR.itin:
5:00 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Very early start)
7:00 AM — Vadakkunnathan temple, Thrissur: Quick darshan at the great Shiva temple, then breakfast in Thrissur, own expense. (Optional · Hindus only)
8:30 AM — Guruvayur Sri Krishna temple: Darshan at 'the Dwarka of the South'. Phones, bags and footwear go to the counters. (Hindus only · strict dress code)
11:45 AM — Mammiyoor Mahadeva temple: The Shiva temple next to Guruvayur. Lunch after, own expense. (Dress code)
1:30 PM — Punnathur Kotta: The temple's elephant yard in an old palace compound. (Entry own expense)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_GURUVAYUR.gtk:
👗 Dress code: Men: mundu, no shirt (a shawl is fine). Women: saree, churidar or long skirt. No jeans, shorts or T-shirts. Mundus and sarees are sold near the temple if needed.
📵 At the temple: Phones, cameras, bags and footwear are not allowed inside — use the paid counters. Queues of 2–4 hours on weekends, Ekadasi and wedding days; keep water and medicines handy.
🙏 Non-Hindu guests: The temples admit Hindus only. You can see the East Nada and gopuram from outside, walk the temple town and visit the elephant yard. Tell us when booking; we'll agree a comfortable meeting point.
🌙 Early start: Pickup at 5:00 AM — rest in the vehicle, breakfast in Thrissur. If queues are very long we may skip Thrissur to stay on time.
EKM_GURUVAYUR.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_GURUVAYUR.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Offerings, special darshan & elephant-yard entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_GURUVAYUR.carry: Mundu / saree / churidar; Small pouch for medicines; Water bottle; Cash for counters

EKM_COK.desc: Catching a flight from Cochin International? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Kochi and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
EKM_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Ernakulam, Fort Kochi, Kakkanad or anywhere in the city — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~30–45 km to Nedumbassery: About 1–1.5 hours via Edappally, Kalamassery and Aluva on NH 544 — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
EKM_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Reach the airport 3 hours before an international flight and 2 hours before a domestic one. From Fort Kochi or at peak hours (8–10 AM, 5–8 PM), allow extra time.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Arriving in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
EKM_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
EKM_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; Water for the drive

EKM_TRV.desc: Flying out of Trivandrum? Start at your own door in Kochi and step out at the right terminal — or land in Trivandrum and we drive you home to Kochi.
EKM_TRV.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home, hotel, Ernakulam South station or Vyttila Hub — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~215 km on NH 66: About 5–6 hours via Alappuzha and Kollam, with a refreshment break on the way.
Drop-off — Trivandrum International Airport: T1 domestic or T2 international (Chakkai). Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
EKM_TRV.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave Kochi at least 8 hours before an international flight and 7 hours before a domestic one. NH 66 is being widened — diversions add time.
🛫 Two terminals: T1 (domestic) and T2 (international, Chakkai) are on opposite sides of the runway. Check your ticket and tell us the terminal.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Trivandrum?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at arrivals. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
EKM_TRV.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
EKM_TRV.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
EKM_TRV.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T2) noted; A light snack for the drive

EKM_MUNNAR.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, tea estates as far as you can see and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Kerala's favourite hill station is just four hours from Kochi.
EKM_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel, Ernakulam South, Vyttila or the airport; about 130 km on NH 85 via Kothamangalam, roughly 4 hours.
Day 1 · 9:30 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · midday — Tea Museum: How tea goes from leaf to cup, at Nullatanni. Lunch in Munnar town. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point: Lake views and optional boating on the Top Station road. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · ~6 PM — Drive home: Leave after lunch; back at your door in Kochi by evening.
EKM_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we go to Top Station instead.
🍃 Tea & spices: Tea estates are private land — photograph from the roadside. Spice gardens at Pallivasal and Kallar are optional, paid direct.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. In heavy-rain alerts hill roads can close at night — we plan to be off the ghat before dark.
EKM_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
EKM_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
EKM_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

EKM_THEKKADY.desc: Walk a cardamom and pepper plantation, catch a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show, and take the morning boat into the Periyar Tiger Reserve — about five hours from Kochi.
EKM_THEKKADY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Ernakulam South, Vyttila or the airport; about 175 km via Pala and the Kuttikkanam ghat, roughly 5–6 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Spice plantation tour: Cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and coffee with a local guide. (Paid direct)
Day 1 · evening — Kathakali or Kalaripayattu: Kerala's classical dance-drama or martial art at a Kumily theatre. Overnight in Thekkady. (Optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Periyar Lake boat cruise: The first sailing — the best time to see elephants, gaur and deer at the water's edge. (Limited seats · tickets in advance)
Day 2 · late morning — Chellarkovil viewpoint: A cliff-edge view over the Cumbum valley and Tamil Nadu plains.
Day 2 · ~7 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat after lunch; back at your door in Kochi by evening.
EKM_THEKKADY.gtk:
🛶 Periyar boating: Only a few sailings a day with limited seats — we help you book tickets in advance. Animal sightings are never guaranteed; boats stop in storms.
🌿 Spice shopping: Buy from plantations or fixed-price shops in Kumily. Leeches on plantation paths in the wet season — wear socks.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Kumily or on Thekkady Road. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🛣️ The drive: Ghat road after Mundakayam — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Cool nights in Thekkady; pleasant all year.
EKM_THEKKADY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Thekkady sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
EKM_THEKKADY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, plantation and show tickets; Tolls and parking
EKM_THEKKADY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Binoculars; Cash for tickets

EKM_VAGAMON.desc: A long private day in Kerala's quiet hills: misty pine forest, rolling green meadows, the Kurisumala skyline and late-afternoon views from Thangalpara, about three hours from Kochi.
EKM_VAGAMON.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Ernakulam South, Vyttila or Cochin Airport. Breakfast at Thodupuzha.
9:30 AM — Pine forest: Walk under tall pines on the slopes just outside Vagamon town. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Vagamon meadows & lake: Rolling grass hills with the Kurisumala view, then the calm lake ringed by tea. Lunch in town.
2:00 PM — Adventure park, Kolahalamedu: Paragliding in season and the glass bridge, when open. (Paid direct · operators confirm)
4:00 PM — Thangalpara: Hilltop rocks and a shrine with sweeping views over the valleys. (Easy uphill walk)
9:00 PM — Drop-off: Down via Erattupetta and Pala, back to your door in Kochi.
EKM_VAGAMON.gtk:
🪂 Paragliding & glass bridge: Paragliding runs in season and only when the weather allows; pay the operator directly. The glass bridge has been closed for repairs — we confirm if it's open before your trip.
🌧️ Weather: Mist rolls in most afternoons; grass slopes are slippery after rain. Best from September to May; heavy-rain alerts can close viewpoints.
⏱️ A long day: About 3 hours each way on narrow hill roads. Prefer a slower pace? Ask us for a 2-day trip with a night in Vagamon.
👟 Walking: Meadows, pine forest and Thangalpara involve short uphill walks. Elderly guests can enjoy most views close to the road.
EKM_VAGAMON.inc: Private vehicle and driver; All Vagamon sightseeing drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
EKM_VAGAMON.exc: Meals; Entry, paragliding and park tickets; Tolls and parking
EKM_VAGAMON.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes with grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Cash for entry fees

EKM_HOUSEBOAT.desc: Drive from Kochi to Alappuzha, board a houseboat by noon and drift through Kuttanad's canals and paddy fields, with a night on the water and a beach stop on the way home.
EKM_HOUSEBOAT.itin:
Day 1 · 9:30 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Ernakulam South, Vyttila or Cochin Airport.
Day 1 · 10:00 AM — Drive to Alappuzha: About 55 km on NH 66 via Aroor and Cherthala, roughly 1.5–2 hours.
Day 1 · 12 noon — Board your houseboat: Cruise the backwaters with lunch, dinner and breakfast cooked on board. Overnight on the boat. (Houseboat booked by you · paid direct)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Check-out at the jetty: Your driver meets you at the boarding point with the vehicle.
Day 2 · 10:00 AM — Alappuzha or Marari beach: Optional — the old pier and lighthouse, or quiet Marari on the way home. (No swimming in rough sea)
Day 2 · ~1:30 PM — Home: Back to your door in Kochi.
EKM_HOUSEBOAT.gtk:
🚤 Booking the houseboat: You book and pay the houseboat directly; we can share contacts of licensed operators we trust. Check-in is usually around noon, check-out about 9 AM.
🛏️ On board: Boats stop cruising by early evening and anchor for the night. Ask the operator about AC hours, menus and life jackets.
🚗 Your driver: The vehicle stays with the driver in Alappuzha overnight. His night allowance is in our price.
🌧️ Season: Best from September to March; peak Dec–Jan — book early. In heavy rain, cruise routes may be shortened.
EKM_HOUSEBOAT.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Kochi ⇄ Alappuzha jetty drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
EKM_HOUSEBOAT.exc: Houseboat (paid direct); Meals off the boat; Tolls and parking
EKM_HOUSEBOAT.carry: Swimwear and a change of clothes; Mosquito repellent; Sunscreen and hat; ID for the houseboat check-in

EKM_CIRCUIT.desc: The classic Kerala holiday from Kochi: two nights in Munnar's tea hills, spice and wildlife in Thekkady, a night on the Alappuzha backwaters and a drop at the airport.
EKM_CIRCUIT.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Kochi to Munnar: From your door, hotel or Cochin Airport; about 130 km past the Cheeyappara falls. Tea Museum in the afternoon. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 — Munnar sightseeing: Eravikulam Park, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point and Top Station. (Entry fees paid direct)
Day 3 · morning — Munnar to Thekkady: About 110 km through cardamom hills; spice plantation walk.
Day 3 · 3:30 PM — Periyar Lake cruise: The afternoon sailing into the tiger reserve, then an optional Kathakali show. (Tickets paid direct · book early)
Day 4 — Thekkady to Alappuzha: About 160 km; board your houseboat around noon for a night on the backwaters. (Houseboat booked by you)
Day 5 · late morning — Kochi or Cochin Airport: About 60–85 km; drop at your door or in time for an afternoon flight.
EKM_CIRCUIT.gtk:
🚤 Houseboats: Book a licensed houseboat early for December–January. Check-in is usually around noon, check-out about 9 AM next day.
🐐 Eravikulam & Periyar: Eravikulam closes for tahr calving around Feb–Mar; book online slots ahead. Periyar boats have limited seats — we help you book.
🏨 Your stays: You book hotels in Munnar and Thekkady, and the houseboat. Your driver's bata and night allowances are in our price.
✈️ Flying out?: On Day 5 we can drop you at Cochin Airport for a flight from about 2 PM. Want more time? Add a night anywhere — ask us.
EKM_CIRCUIT.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 5 days; All sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
EKM_CIRCUIT.exc: Hotels and houseboat; Meals; Entry, boat and show tickets; Tolls and parking
EKM_CIRCUIT.carry: Warm layer for Munnar; Walking shoes; Mosquito repellent; Cash for entry fees

EKM_WAYANAD.desc: Up the nine hairpins of the Thamarassery ghat to Kerala's green north: forest lakes, the country's largest earth dam and Edakkal's ancient carvings — your own vehicle and driver.
EKM_WAYANAD.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Wayanad: From your door in Kochi — about 270 km via Thrissur, Kozhikode and the Thamarassery ghat, roughly 8 hours with breaks. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · afternoon — Lakkidi viewpoint & Pookode Lake: The view back down the ghat, then a forest lake right on the way in. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Edakkal Caves: A short, steep climb to caves with prehistoric rock carvings. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with green islands in the reservoir. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 2 · or swap in — Chembra, Soochipara or Kuruva: A peak trek, a forest waterfall or bamboo-raft river islands — pick one. (Seasonal · we check if open)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back at your door in Kochi by evening.
EKM_WAYANAD.gtk:
🪨 Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays — we plan around it. The climb is steep: not ideal for elders or small children.
🌧️ Seasonal spots: Kuruva Island closes in the monsoon and has a daily visitor cap; treks and falls can shut after heavy rain. We check on the day and swap stops.
🏨 Your stay: You book your resort or homestay; Kalpetta and Vythiri are central. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
⛰️ The ghat: Thamarassery ghat jams on weekends and holidays. We start early both ways to beat the queues.
EKM_WAYANAD.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
EKM_WAYANAD.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and trek fees; Tolls and parking
EKM_WAYANAD.carry: Trekking shoes; Raincoat; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

EKM_OOTY.desc: The Nilgiris' classic hill stations: gardens, a lake and the highest peak in Ooty, tea country in Coonoor, and the famous toy train — your vehicle, your pace.
EKM_OOTY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Ooty: From your door in Kochi — about 285 km via Palakkad, Coimbatore, Mettupalayam and the Coonoor ghat, roughly 8–9 hours. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · evening — Ooty Lake: An easy first evening: a walk or a boat on the lake. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Botanical Garden & Doddabetta: Ooty's 1840s gardens, then the highest point in the Nilgiris. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Coonoor — Sim's Park & Dolphin's Nose: Tea country, a hillside garden and a famous valley lookout.
Day 2 · optional — Nilgiri Mountain Railway: Ride the UNESCO-listed toy train between Ooty and Coonoor; we meet you at the other end. (Tickets in advance · paid direct)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back at your door in Kochi by evening.
EKM_OOTY.gtk:
🎫 Nilgiris e-pass: Every vehicle entering the Nilgiris needs a Tamil Nadu e-pass — we apply for it. Single-use plastic is banned: carry refillable steel bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Ooty is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🚂 Toy train: Seats sell out — book on IRCTC well before your trip. Timings change; we confirm them with you.
🧥 Weather: Cold nights all year — bring warm clothes. The ghat has many hairpins; carry motion sickness tablets.
EKM_OOTY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Ooty and Coonoor sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
EKM_OOTY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and toy train tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
EKM_OOTY.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Refillable water bottle; Cash for entry fees

EKM_KODAIKANAL.desc: A star-shaped lake, cliff-edge walks and pillar rocks in the Palani hills — up the ghat from Palani to Tamil Nadu's cool retreat, with your own vehicle and driver.
EKM_KODAIKANAL.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Kodaikanal: From your door in Kochi — about 310 km via Palakkad, Pollachi, Palani and the Kodai ghat, roughly 9 hours. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · evening — Kodai Lake: A walk, a cycle or a boat round the star-shaped lake. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Coaker's Walk & Bryant Park: A cliff-edge path with views to the plains, then the gardens. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Pillar Rocks, pine forest & Guna Caves viewpoint: Granite pillars, tall pines and the famous caves lookout. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back at your door in Kochi by evening.
EKM_KODAIKANAL.gtk:
🎫 Kodaikanal e-pass: Tourist vehicles need a Tamil Nadu e-pass for Kodaikanal — we apply for it. Plastic is restricted: carry refillable bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🌫️ Viewpoints: Mist can hide Pillar Rocks and Coaker's Walk — mornings are usually clearer. We reorder stops for the best views.
🧥 Weather: Cool all year, cold at night — bring warm layers. The ghat is winding: carry motion sickness tablets.
EKM_KODAIKANAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Kodaikanal sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
EKM_KODAIKANAL.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
EKM_KODAIKANAL.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

EKM_MYSORE.desc: Up the Thamarassery ghat to Wayanad, through the Bandipur forest to Mysore's palace, Chamundi Hill, Brindavan and Srirangapatna — a royal road trip in your own vehicle.
EKM_MYSORE.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Wayanad: From your door in Kochi — about 270 km via Thrissur, Kozhikode and the Thamarassery ghat. Overnight in Wayanad. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Wayanad to Mysore via Bandipur: About 140 km through Muthanga and Bandipur forests — watch for deer and elephants. (Forest road closed at night)
Day 2 · evening — Srirangapatna & Brindavan Gardens: Tipu Sultan's island fort, then the gardens and musical fountain below KRS dam. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 · morning — Mysore Palace: The Wodeyars' palace of stained glass, mirrors and carved doors. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 · afternoon — Chamundi Hill & the lit-up palace: The hilltop temple and city view; the palace lights up on Sunday and holiday evenings. (Illumination Sun & holidays)
Day 4 · 6:00 AM — Long drive home: About 410 km via Gundlupet, Wayanad and Kozhikode; back in Kochi by night.
EKM_MYSORE.gtk:
🏰 Mysore Palace: Plan a Sunday or public holiday for the evening illumination. Shoes are removed inside — carry socks.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Mysore is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🐘 Bandipur road: The forest stretch is closed to traffic from 9 PM to 6 AM — we cross in daylight. No stopping or feeding animals inside the forest.
🏨 Your stays: You book one night in Wayanad and two in Mysore. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
EKM_MYSORE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 4 days; All Mysore and Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
EKM_MYSORE.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Palace, garden and entry fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
EKM_MYSORE.carry: Photo ID; Socks for the palace; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

EKM_VARKALA.desc: Red cliffs over the Arabian Sea and a Varkala sunset, then Trivandrum's great Padmanabhaswamy temple and the Napier Museum — or an afternoon at Kovalam.
EKM_VARKALA.itin:
Day 1 · 7:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door in Kochi. About 170 km on NH 66 via Alappuzha and Kollam, 4–5 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Varkala Cliff & Papanasam Beach: Cliff-top walk and cafés, then steps down to the beach — strong currents. (Swim only at flagged spots)
Day 1 · ~5 PM — Janardana Swamy Temple: The ancient Vishnu temple on the hill above Papanasam. (Dress code · Hindus only inside)
Day 1 · sunset — Sunset on the cliff: Golden hour from the North Cliff. Overnight in Varkala. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 8:30 AM — Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple: About 50 km to Trivandrum for morning darshan at the great Vishnu temple. (Strict dress code · Hindus only)
Day 2 · late morning — Napier Museum or Kovalam: Art and history in the Museum gardens — or a beach lunch at Kovalam. (Museum closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · ~8 PM — Home or airport: About 210 km back to your door in Kochi — or a drop at Trivandrum Airport.
EKM_VARKALA.gtk:
🌊 Beach safety: Varkala's sea has strong currents and rip tides — swim only between lifeguard flags. No sea bathing in the monsoon (June–September); cliff paths are slippery after rain.
🛕 Temple rules: Padmanabhaswamy: Hindus only. Men in mundu, no shirt; women in saree or long skirt — mundus can be hired at the gate. Phones and cameras are not allowed inside.
🗓️ Closing days: Napier Museum is closed on Mondays and opens only at 1 PM on Wednesdays — on those days we head to Kovalam. The temple closes for a few hours at midday.
🏨 Stay & flights: You book your Varkala stay; North Cliff is the liveliest area. Flying out? End Day 2 at Trivandrum Airport — tell us your flight time.
EKM_VARKALA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Varkala & Trivandrum sightseeing; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
EKM_VARKALA.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry fees and offerings; Tolls and parking
EKM_VARKALA.carry: Swimwear and towel; Temple clothes (mundu / saree); Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

EKM_KANYAKUMARI.desc: India's southern tip: the wooden palace of the Travancore kings, a sunset and a sunrise where three seas meet, and a ferry to Vivekananda Rock and the Thiruvalluvar statue.
EKM_KANYAKUMARI.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door in Kochi. About 300 km on NH 66 via Trivandrum, 7–8 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 2:00 PM — Padmanabhapuram Palace: The Travancore kings' carved wooden palace at Thuckalay, on the way. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · evening — Sunset at Kanyakumari: Watch the sun go down at the tip of India. Overnight in Kanyakumari. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · ~6 AM — Sunrise over three seas: The famous sunrise from the shore by the temple.
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Vivekananda Rock & Thiruvalluvar statue: Government ferry to the rock memorial; a glass bridge links it to the statue. (Ferry paid direct · go early)
Day 2 · late morning — Kumari Amman Temple: The ancient shore temple of the virgin goddess. (Men remove shirts · dress code)
Day 2 · ~9 PM — Home: About 300 km back to Kochi — Suchindram temple on the way if you wish.
EKM_KANYAKUMARI.gtk:
🛂 Tamil Nadu entry: Kanyakumari is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We arrange the permit before your trip.
⛴️ The Rock ferry: Government ferries run from about 8 AM to 4 PM; queues grow after 9 — go early. Tickets paid direct; ferries pause when the sea is rough.
🛕 Palace & temple: Padmanabhapuram Palace is closed on Mondays — on a Monday we visit Suchindram instead. Kumari Amman: men remove shirts; modest dress for all.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; sea-view rooms near the sunrise point fill fast. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
EKM_KANYAKUMARI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Palace, sunset & temple drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
EKM_KANYAKUMARI.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Ferry, palace and temple tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
EKM_KANYAKUMARI.carry: Photo ID; Modest temple clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for ferry and entry

EKM_NELLIYAMPATHY.desc: Tipu Sultan's fort and the Malampuzha gardens on day one, then ten hairpins up to Nelliyampathy's orange farms, tea estates and cliff-top views on day two.
EKM_NELLIYAMPATHY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Ernakulam South, Vyttila or the airport; about 150 km on NH 544 via Thrissur, roughly 4 hours.
Day 1 · late morning — Palakkad Fort: Tipu Sultan's 18th-century granite fort in the heart of town, with its moat and ramparts. (Open ≈8 AM–6 PM)
Day 1 · evening — Malampuzha Dam & gardens: Landscaped gardens below the dam, the ropeway and an evening stroll. Overnight in Palakkad. (Entry own expense · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 7:00 AM — Up to Nelliyampathy: Via Nenmara and Pothundy dam, then ten hairpins through the forest to Kaikatty. (Forest check post on the way)
Day 2 · morning — Seethargundu & orange farm: Cliff-top views over the Kollengode plains, Kesavanpara, the government orange farm and tea estates. Lunch in the hills. (Short walks)
Day 2 · ~7:30 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat by mid-afternoon; back at your door in Kochi by evening.
EKM_NELLIYAMPATHY.gtk:
🛣️ Nelliyampathy ghat: About 10 hairpins between Pothundy and Kaikatty — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Vehicles are logged at the forest check post; we go up early and come down before dark.
⛲ Malampuzha: The gardens are best in the late afternoon and evening. Ropeway, boating and snake park are optional, paid direct.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Palakkad town or near Malampuzha. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🌧️ Weather: Best from September to February; cool mornings in the hills. Heavy monsoon rain can bring landslips on the ghat — we re-check the day before.
EKM_NELLIYAMPATHY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Palakkad and Nelliyampathy sightseeing; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
EKM_NELLIYAMPATHY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Fort, garden and ropeway fees; Tolls and parking
EKM_NELLIYAMPATHY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

EKM_SABARIMALA.desc: Your own vehicle from Kochi to Nilakkal base camp for the 2026-27 Mandala–Makaravilakku season, with an Erumely stop if you wish — the driver waits to bring you home.
EKM_SABARIMALA.itin:
≈3:30 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Ernakulam South, Vyttila or Cochin Airport. (Example: 10 AM slot)
On the road — Via Kottayam & Ponkunnam: About 150 km (or via Muvattupuzha and Pala), with a tea break.
≈6:30 AM — Erumely (optional): Petta Thullal at the Petta Sastha temple and a visit to Vavar Palli. (Tell us when booking)
≈8:30 AM — Nilakkal base camp: Private vehicles stop here; KSRTC chain buses take you on to Pampa. (Bus fare paid direct)
Day — Pampa, the climb & darshan: About 5 km uphill on foot to Sannidhanam, darshan, and the walk back. (Virtual Queue booked by you)
≈Midnight — Home: Your driver waits at Nilakkal and brings you home the same night.
EKM_SABARIMALA.gtk:
📱 Virtual Queue: Book your darshan slot yourself at sabarimalaonline.org; carry the QR coupon and the same photo ID. Spot-booking counters are limited — don't count on them.
🅿️ Nilakkal & Pampa: Private vehicles are not allowed to Pampa — KSRTC chain buses run from Nilakkal. Save your driver's number and the parking block.
🗓️ Season 2026-27: The temple opens on 16 Nov 2026; Mandala Pooja is on 27 Dec; Makaravilakku in mid-January 2027. Peak days bring police holds and long queues — we re-confirm before you travel.
❤️ The climb: About 5 km of steep forest path — go slow; medical centres with oxygen line the route. Elderly pilgrims and heart patients: check with your doctor first.
EKM_SABARIMALA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Erumely stop on request; Driver bata; No waiting charges at Nilakkal
EKM_SABARIMALA.exc: KSRTC Nilakkal–Pampa bus; Meals and offerings; Virtual Queue booking (done by you); Tolls and parking
EKM_SABARIMALA.carry: QR coupon and photo ID; Irumudi kettu; Torch and a warm layer; Your medicines and water

EKM_VELANKANNI.desc: Through the Palakkad Gap and across the Kaveri delta to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, candle prayers and a full, unhurried day at the shrine by the sea.
EKM_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:30 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (≈550 km via Coimbatore & Trichy)
Day 1 · evening — Evening prayer: Reach Velankanni by about 5:30 PM; candles and prayer at the Shrine Basilica. (Room booked by you)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Malayalam Mass at the Morning Star Church, then Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross. (Times re-confirmed)
Day 2 · late morning — Museum & Old Church: The museum of offerings and the Old Church by Our Lady's Tank. Lunch near the shrine (own expense).
Day 2 · evening — Beach & candle prayers: A walk on Velankanni beach, then the evening rosary and candles at the basilica. (No sea bathing)
Day 3 · ≈6:00 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city (Leaves Velankanni 5 AM)
EKM_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Shoulders and knees covered; follow the volunteers in the queues and keep silence in the chapels. Masses run daily in Tamil, English and other languages — we re-confirm the Malayalam Mass time before you travel.
🌊 Beach & crowds: No sea bathing — the sea is rough and drownings are reported. We fix one meeting point at the main arch; children stay with an adult.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room near the shrine — we share a list of pilgrim lodges. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long road & border: About 550 km each way on highways, with breaks every 2–3 hours. Tamil Nadu permit and border tax at actual cost; carry a photo ID.
EKM_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_VELANKANNI.exc: Your room; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
EKM_VELANKANNI.carry: Photo ID; Modest clothes for church; Light cotton and a sun cap; Cash for offerings and candles

EKM_KATHAKALI.desc: Cross the harbour on Kochi's electric Water Metro, watch the sun go down at Fort Kochi, see Kathakali artists paint their faces and perform, then the fire of Kalaripayattu.
EKM_KATHAKALI.itin:
2:30 PM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup from 1:45 on request)
3:30 PM — Water Metro to Fort Kochi: A 20-odd-minute glide across the harbour from the High Court terminal; we meet you at Fort Kochi. (Ticket own expense)
4:15 PM — Fort Kochi beach at sunset: The promenade as the boats come in, with tea and snacks, own expense. (No swimming)
5:00 PM — Kathakali make-up & show: Watch the green 'pacha' faces painted, then a story told in mudras to live drums and song. (Show ticket own expense)
7:15 PM — Kalaripayattu: Kerala's martial art — leaps, sticks, swords and shields. Dinner in Fort Kochi after. (Show ticket own expense)
9:30 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_KATHAKALI.gtk:
🎭 The shows: We book your seats at a Fort Kochi Kathakali theatre; tickets are paid there. A narrator explains the story before it begins. Come early for the make-up — it is half the magic. Front rows sit close to the drums.
⛴️ Water Metro: Air-conditioned electric boats from the High Court terminal; tickets at the counter or by card. If boats are full or stopped, we drive you to Fort Kochi instead.
📸 Etiquette: Photos are usually fine during the show — no flash, no standing in the aisle. Phones on silent; children are welcome.
🌙 Late finish: Drop-off from about 9:30 PM — Ernakulam South and Vyttila first. Want to stay out in Fort Kochi? Tell your caretaker and find your own way back.
EKM_KATHAKALI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_KATHAKALI.exc: Show & Water Metro tickets; Tea and dinner; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_KATHAKALI.carry: Light, cool clothes; Cash or UPI for tickets; Mosquito repellent; Phone with our number saved

EKM_MUZIRIS.desc: The old Muziris country north of Kochi: two restored synagogues, Chendamangalam's handloom weavers, the Paliam palace of the Kochi prime ministers, then sunset on the Kadamakudy islands.
EKM_MUZIRIS.itin:
8:30 AM — Pickup: Ernakulam South station · Vyttila Hub · Cochin Airport (on request) (Airport pickup from 8:00 on request)
9:45 AM — Paravur synagogue: The 1615 synagogue, now Kerala's Jewish history museum. (Ticket own expense)
11:00 AM — Chendamangalam looms: Kasavu sarees and set-mundu woven on wooden looms. Buy direct. (Weekdays & Saturdays)
12:00 PM — Kottayil Kovilakam hill: Synagogue, temple, church and mosque side by side. Lunch after. (Modest dress)
2:45 PM — Paliam palace & Nalukettu: The Paliath Achans' 'Dutch palace' and home, now museums. (Ticket own expense)
5:15 PM — Kadamakudy islands: Pokkali paddy, prawn farms and island lanes at sunset. (No swimming)
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Ernakulam South, Vyttila, Airport, or your own stop in the city
EKM_MUZIRIS.gtk:
🏛️ Museum days: The Muziris museums open about 10 AM–5 PM and the weavers work Monday to Saturday, so this tour runs Tuesday to Saturday. Museum tickets are bought at each gate or online; a guide explains the galleries.
🕍 Respect: Synagogues, temple, church and mosque: shoulders and knees covered; footwear off where asked. No photos inside the synagogue galleries unless the staff allow it.
🧵 Handloom: The looms are people's workplaces — watch quietly and ask before photos. Sarees and mundu are sold at fixed society prices; carry cash or UPI.
🌅 Kadamakudy: A quiet village, not a resort — narrow lanes and open water with no railings. Toddy shops line the islands; our group stops for views, tea and snacks only.
EKM_MUZIRIS.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
EKM_MUZIRIS.exc: Lunch and snacks; Museum tickets (paid direct); Handloom shopping; Tolls and parking (private trips)
EKM_MUZIRIS.carry: Modest clothes (shoulders, knees); Easy slip-on footwear; Cap and water bottle; Cash or UPI for tickets & shopping

EKM_EV_CARNIVAL.desc: See in the New Year at Fort Kochi: lights, music and crowds on the beach and Parade Ground, and at midnight the giant Pappanji effigy burns. We drop you at the nearest open point and bring you home after. Event dates: Thu 31 Dec 2026 · Pappanji at midnight (Fixed date — programme set by the Carnival committee & police).
EKM_EV_CARNIVAL.itin:
6:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Ernakulam South station, Vyttila Hub or Cochin Airport.
7:00 PM — Drop near Fort Kochi: As close as the police allow — vehicles are stopped well before Fort Kochi on New Year's Eve. (Walk the last stretch)
Evening — Carnival night: Music, lights and street food around Vasco da Gama Square, the beach and the Parade Ground. (Very crowded)
Midnight — Pappanji burns: The giant 'old man' effigy is set alight as the New Year comes in. (Main moment)
2:30 AM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point once the police open the roads; back home or to your hotel.
EKM_EV_CARNIVAL.gtk:
🎭 The carnival: The Cochin Carnival runs in Fort Kochi through the second half of December, with rallies, games and shows. It ends on New Year's Eve, when Pappanji — a giant effigy of the old year — is burned at midnight.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.

🎒 On the night: Keep phones and wallets in front pockets; agree a meeting point by a landmark, not the beach. Children: write your number on their wrist; the crowd is dense after midnight.

EKM_EV_MAKAM.gtk:
🙏 Makam Thozhal: The seventh day of the Chottanikkara festival in Kumbham; the Devi is decorated in gold and devotees believe this darshan grants their wishes. The sanctum opens around 2 PM and devotees keep coming until about 9:30 PM.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.

🛕 Temple rules: Men: shirts off, dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear at the counter. Hindus only inside the temple; queues are long — carry water, keep children close.

EKM_EV_MALAYATTOOR.gtk:
⛪ Malayattoor: Tradition holds that St Thomas the Apostle prayed on this hill; the shrine on Kurisumudi is an international pilgrim centre. Pilgrims climb through Lent and Holy Week; the feast peaks on Puthunjayar, the Sunday after Easter.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Easter is on 28 March 2027, so Puthunjayar falls on Sunday 4 April; the eighth-day feast follows the next Sunday. The church announces the programme — we re-confirm before your trip.
⛰️ The climb: Steep and rocky, about an hour up for most — good shoes, water, go slow. Guests with heart, knee or breathing problems can pray at the church at the foot and wait there.

EKM_EV_SIVARATHRI.gtk:
🕉️ Aluva Sivarathri: One of Kerala's great Sivarathri gatherings: devotees keep vigil on the Manappuram, the sand-bank of the Periyar, at the Aluva Shiva temple. After midnight, families perform bali tharpanam for their ancestors on the riverbank; a fair runs alongside for weeks.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Maha Shivaratri falls on Saturday 6 March 2027; the vigil runs that night and bali continues into the morning of 7 March. The Devaswom Board fixes the timings — we re-confirm before your trip.
🌊 By the river: The Periyar is deep and fast — stay on the steps and the marked area; never let children into the water. Wear clothes you can get wet in; carry a towel and a dry change.
